title: Verify hub: Tier 3 liveness card label, verified state and route

requirements.expectation: The Tier 3 card shows Start and is clickable when Tier 2 is approved, Locked and inert before Tier 2, and Verified and inert after liveness.
evidence: code: src/components/verify/__tests__/tier3-liveness-card.test.tsx covers all three states and click handling.

requirements.expectation: The verify hub reads faceLivenessVerified for the Verified state and routes the card to /verify/tier-3, not /settings/security.
evidence: code: verification-screen.tsx passes v.userProfile?.faceLivenessVerified and router.push('/verify/tier-3'). Typecheck is clean.

requirements.expectation: /verify/tier-3 runs FaceLiveness with serverVerify for a Pro with Tier 2 approved. It shows a notice instead for non-Pros, Pros without Tier 2 and Pros already verified. On a pass it refreshes the profile cache and returns to /verify.
evidence: code: tier3-liveness-screen.tsx. No browser run (see H1).

requirements.expectation: lint has 0 errors; typecheck and the full test suite pass; new files stay at or under 300 lines.
